basis: Cerence’s February 7 release forecast consolidated GAAP revenue of $82,000,000 to $86,000,000 for fiscal Q2 2022, the quarter ending March 31, 2022. The high end was 12.83% below prior-year GAAP revenue of $98,662,000 and below the $93,728,900 cutoff. This was the earliest qualifying quarter-specific disclosure found.

coverage.detail: November 22, 2021. The preceding earnings cycle gave revenue ranges of $91 million to $96 million for fiscal Q1 ending December 31 and $400 million to $425 million for all of FY2022. Neither range established a ceiling for the March quarter. A search of the accompanying call transcript also found no March-quarter revenue range.
December 15, 2021. Management reaffirmed the November range specifically for fiscal Q1.

January 6, 2022. Cerence announced its January 11 Needham conference appearance. The notice supplied no revenue outlook, and the search for public management remarks before February 7 found no earlier qualifying Q2 forecast.

February 7, 2022. The earnings-call presentation independently identifies fiscal Q2 2022 revenue guidance of $82 million to $86 million alongside fiscal Q2 2021 actual revenue of $98.7 million. The release’s guidance reconciliation explicitly labels the forecast GAAP revenue.
February 24, 2022. Cerence announced three investor conference appearances after the qualifying release. The notice gave no revised Q2 revenue range.
March 15, 2022. The intervening 8-K reported the CFO appointment and compensation terms. It contained no Q2 revenue update.

May 6, 2022. Cerence estimated preliminary Q2 revenue at $85.5 million to $86.5 million, still entirely below the cutoff. It also expressly attributed its original $82 million to $86 million Q2 range to February 7.

May 10, 2022. The consolidated statements report total revenue of $86,280,000 and $98,662,000 for the three months ended March 31, 2022 and 2021, respectively. The GAAP revenue reconciliation confirms both figures on the same reported basis.

publication_date_evidence: Cerence’s IR release is datelined February 7, 2022 and marked “Released February 7, 2022.” Its contemporaneous [Form 8-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1768267/000119312522029093/d219536d8k.htm) confirms that Cerence announced the results and used the investor presentation that day.
